rule: a reduction doubled, to its floor
reasoning: the base crit chance is 10% (`CRIT_CHANCE`) and the stamp floors a unit's total at zero, so doubling the 5 points taken takes every unit's base crit to zero — the deepest the rule allows
the clamp takes half the bar; doubling what it takes takes all of it, so both parties open every fight with nothing in hand — the floor of a clamp, the rule unchanged
a bonus has no ceiling to stop at, so the plain step is three times: every fire strike +75%, whoever deals it

a quarter of all Break damage taken away, doubled to a half: the meters fill at half speed on both sides
one turn off every status, doubled to two (never below one): a three-turn buff lasts one

rule: derived against the reach test: the fight's length
